# AMR genes

## 1. Methods

Data was evaluated with fastqc and determined to have nextera transposase adapter contamination. Data was run through Nephele's QC pipeline for adapter trimming. Trimmed data was passed through WGSA2 pipeline in Nephele where it was decontaminated for human reads. AMR detection was performed on assemblies using AMR-Finder as a part of the WGSA2 pipeline. CPM (equivalent to TPM) of AMR genes were used in this analysis. 

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(phyloseq)
library(metagMisc)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(knitr)
library(GUniFrac)
library(ggrepel)
library(MMUPHin)
library(ggprism)
library(ggbreak)
library(microbial)
library(devtools)
library(pairwiseAdonis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
library(ggtext)
library(veganEx)
library(kableExtra)
library(pixiedust)
library(downloadthis)
```


## 2. Data processing 

### Import data

Created phyloseq object. 

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## Input data "Final_AMR_table.csv" is formatted with the first column contains the AMR gene (in this case accession number)
## The remaining columns are samples with abundance of each AMR gene. 
## "taxa" in this case are the different classifications of each gene for the phyloseq object. This was provided as a part of AMR-Finder output.
## Example: kingdom: ARSENIC;	phylum: ARSENITE;	class: arsD	order: arsenite efflux transporter metallochaperone ArsD;	family arsD_arsenite efflux transporter metallochaperone ArsD; OTU: AAA21094_1

data<-read.csv("Final_AMR_table.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)

taxa <- data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","OTU")]
data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","OTU","family")] <- NULL 



```


```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## The first column in the metadata contains rows of sample IDs that correspond to the samples in the input data. Each subsequent column is a different piece of metadata. 


metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

# Removed positive controls for final analysis 
metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)
metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)


otu<-otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
meta<-sample_data(metadata)
tax<-tax_table(as.matrix(taxa))

phylo_raw<-phyloseq(otu, meta, tax)
phylo_raw_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo_raw, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_raw_df)<-phylo_raw_df[,1]
phylo_raw_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_raw_df, -c("OTU"))
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(phylo_raw))
phylo_raw_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_raw_df))
#pairwise.adonis2(phylo_raw_df~SequenceRun, data=metadata)

phylo_raw

```

### Filtering

Filtered for prevalence (10%) and abundance (CPM of 3). 

```{r}


#critical_value <- 0.00001*sum(taxa_sums(phylo_raw))
#phylo <- filter_taxa(phylo_raw, function(x) sum(x) > critical_value, TRUE)
#phylo

phylo<-phyloseq_filter_prevalence(phylo_raw, abund.trh= 3, prev.trh=0.1, abund.type="total", threshold_condition ="AND")
phylo

summary(sample_sums(phylo))

phylo_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_df)<-phylo_df[,1]
phylo_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_df, -c("OTU"))



```

## 3. AMR gene composition

Used permutational multivariate analysis of variance (PERMANOVA) to assess differences in microbial community composition between groups. 

### 3.1 Permanova 

#### 3.1.1 Bray-Curtis


```{r}

phylo_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_df))
bray<-pairwise.adonis2(phylo_df~Timepoint, data=metadata)

results_df <- do.call(rbind, bray)
results_df <- results_df[grepl("Model", rownames(results_df)), ]
results_df$Comparison<-rownames(results_df)
results_df<- results_df %>% mutate(Comparison = gsub(".Model", "", Comparison))
rownames(results_df)<-results_df$Comparison

results_df<-results_df %>% mutate_at(1:5, as.numeric)
results_df[c(1:5)] <- lapply(results_df[c(1:5)], round, digits = 3)

results_df[,c(1,2,6)]<-NULL
results_df %>% kable(caption="<strong>Table X. Differences in AMR gene composition using Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity.<strong>", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:80%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped"))%>%
   column_spec(4, color=ifelse(results_df[,3] < 0.05, "green","black"))


library(downloadthis)
results_df %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "PERMANOVAresults-pathways-bray",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )


```

<br><br>

```{r fig.cap="**Figure X. PCoA depicting relationships between samples based on eukaryotic species using Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity.**", fig.align='left'}

ord_filt_subject<- ordinate(phylo, "MDS", "bray")  
all_pcoa_subject1 <- plot_ordination(phylo, ord_filt_subject, type = "site", 
                                   color = "Timepoint") + 
  geom_point(size = 1) + theme_bw()+ scale_colour_brewer(type="qual", palette="Paired") +stat_ellipse(level=0.95) +

  annotate(geom="text", x=-0.4, y=0.85, label="Day0 v Day2 ; p = 0.001",size=3, fontface="bold")+
  annotate(geom="text", x=-0.40, y=0.95, label="Day2 v Day8 ; p = 0.001",size=3, fontface="bold")+
  annotate(geom="text", x=-0.392, y=1.05, label="Day2 v Day14 ; p = 0.001",size=3, fontface="bold")+
  annotate(geom="text", x=-0.39, y=1.15, label="Day2 v Day28 ; p = 0.001",size=3, fontface="bold")
all_pcoa_subject1


#ggexport(all_pcoa_subject1, filename="PCoA_AMRs_Timepoints_with_stats_bray.pdf", width=7, height=4)

library(downloadthis)
all_pcoa_subject1 %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "PCOA_bray_AMR",
    output_extension = ".pdf",
    button_label = "Download figure as .pdf",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa-solid fa-image",
    ggsave_args = list(height=4, width=7)
  )

```

## 4. Differential abundance 

Used Maaslin2 to look for differentially abundant taxa between timepoints after BSS and day 0 using a linear model ("LM"). SubjectID and Sequence Run were incorporated as random effects.

```{r results=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE}

library(Maaslin2)
family<-tax_glom(phylo, "family")
family_df<-phyloseq_to_df(family, addtax=F)
rownames(family_df)<-family_df[,1]
family_df[,1]<-NULL

metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(family))

subject_all = Maaslin2(
  input_data = family_df,
  input_metadata = metadata, 
  output = "Timepoint_DAA_LM_Day0_AMR",
  fixed_effects = c('Timepoint'), normalization="NONE", reference=c("Timepoint,Day 0"), random_effect=c("SubjectID", "SequenceRun"), analysis_method="LM", transform="LOG", plot_scatter = FALSE)

 LM<-subject_all$results



table<-as.data.frame(LM[,c("feature","value","coef","qval","N.not.zero")])
table$OTU<-table$feature
#write.csv(DAA_taxa, "DAA_species.csv")

DAA_taxa<-merge.data.frame(table, taxa, by="OTU", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)


```

```{r}

table_sub<- DAA_taxa %>% filter(qval < 0.05)
table_sub2<- table_sub %>% filter(coef< -1)
table_sub3<- table_sub %>% filter(coef > 1)
table_sub4<-rbind(table_sub2, table_sub3)

#write.csv(table_sub4, "DAA_AMRs.csv")

table_sub4[table_sub4=="AMINOGLYCOSIDE_ AMINOGLYCOSIDE"] <- "AMINOGLYCOSIDE"
table_sub4[table_sub4=="BETA_LACTAM_ BETA_LACTAM_ BETA_LACTAM"] <- "BETA_LACTAM"
table_sub4[table_sub4=="BETA_LACTAM_ BETA_LACTAM"] <- "BETA_LACTAM"
table_sub4[table_sub4=="TETRACYCLINE_ TETRACYCLINE"] <- "TETRACYCLINE"
table_sub4[table_sub4=="ARSENIC"] <- "METALS"
table_sub4[table_sub4=="COPPER_SILVER"] <- "METALS"
table_sub4[table_sub4=="SILVER"] <- "METALS"
table_sub4[table_sub4=="Unknown"] <- "Other"


table_sub4$kingdom<- factor(table_sub4$kingdom,
    levels = c('AMINOGLYCOSIDE','BETA_LACTAM','EFFLUX','GLYCOPEPTIDE','METALS','TETRACYCLINE','Other'), ordered = TRUE)


table_sub4<- table_sub4 %>% mutate(class = gsub("_", " ", class))
table_sub4<- table_sub4 %>% mutate(class = gsub("  ", ", ", class))

table_sub5<-table_sub4[,c(1,4,5,7:10)] 
names(table_sub5)[1]<-"gene"
names(table_sub5)[4]<-"Class"
names(table_sub5)[5]<-"Subclass"
names(table_sub5)[6]<-"Gene"
names(table_sub5)[7]<-"Description"

table_sub5$qval<-formatC(table_sub5$qval, format = "e", digits = 2)
table_sub5$coef<-round(table_sub5$coef, digits = 2)

table_sub5 <- table_sub5[order(table_sub5$qval, decreasing=FALSE),]

table_sub5[] <- lapply(table_sub5 , gsub, pattern = "_", replacement = " ")

dust(table_sub5) %>%
  kable(caption = "<strong>Table X. Differentially abundant AMR genes at day 2 compared to day 0.<strong>") %>% column_spec(column=3, width_min="5em", include_thead = T)  %>% column_spec(column=1, width_min="10em", include_thead = T) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped")) %>% 
  scroll_box(width = "800px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T)


library(downloadthis)
table_sub5 %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Differentally abundant AMR genes",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )

```

### 4.1 AMR barchart



```{r}

table_sub4$class<- factor(table_sub4$class, levels = table_sub4$class[order(table_sub4$kingdom, table_sub4$coef, decreasing=TRUE)])

#nb.cols<-9
#mycolors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "PiYG"))(nb.cols)
mycolors<-c("#8E0152", "#CB3189","#FAD5E9","#DAF0BD","#599C29","#276419","#F7F7F7")

```

```{r}

stacked_species<-ggplot(table_sub4, aes(x = coef, y = class, fill=kingdom)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",show.legend = TRUE) + xlab("Effect size") +scale_fill_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_classic()+geom_col(color="black")+theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), legend.text=element_text(size=9))+ylab(NULL)+guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 4))+labs(fill="Class")



```

```{r}
mycolors<-c("#8E0152", "#CB3189","#FAD5E9","#DAF0BD","#599C29","#276419","#F7F7F7")
```


```{r}


table_sub4$qval_adj<-(-log10(table_sub4$qval))

bubble_species<-ggplot(table_sub4, aes(x=value, y=class, size = qval_adj)) + geom_point(alpha=1, aes(color=kingdom))+scale_size_area("p val", breaks = c(2,4,6, 8))+scale_color_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_void()+guides(color="none", fill="none")

ggexport(stacked_species+bubble_species, filename="Stacked_plot_AMR_w_qval_v2.pdf",width=5, height=6)

```



```{r fig.cap="**Figure X. Differentially abundant AMR genes (effect size > 1 or <  - 1) 2 days (day 2) after compared to day before (day 0) BSS administration. Significance represents -log10 of adjusted p value after multiple comparisons (< 0.05). The greater the circle the more statistically significant.**", fig.width=5, fig.height=6}

figure<-stacked_species + bubble_species
figure


library(downloadthis)
figure %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Stacked_plot_AMRgenes",
    output_extension = ".pdf",
    button_label = "Download figure as .pdf",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa-solid fa-image",
    ggsave_args = list(height=6, width=5)
  )


```
